description: This is a test class for the UserDao in the OrangeHRM Admin Plugin, specifically testing user data access operations such as save, retrieve, and check existence of users, along with utility methods for user roles and employees.

classes.name: UserDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the UserDao class methods related to user management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of UserDao and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole entity by ID for use in tests.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee entity by employee number for use in tests.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUser
methods.description: Tests saving a new User entity and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForNonExistingUser
methods.description: Verifies that querying for a non-existent user returns null.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForExistingUser
methods.description: Verifies that querying for an existing user returns a User instance.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForDeletedUser
methods.description: Verifies that a deleted user returns null when queried.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForEmptyPasswordUser
methods.description: Verifies that a user with an empty password returns null.

methods.name: testGetSystemUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving a system user by ID.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserForNonExistingId
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a non-existent user ID returns null.

methods.name: testGetAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Tests fetching assignable user roles and verifies their names and count.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of system user IDs.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdListForOneActiveUser
methods.description: Verifies that the method correctly filters active users after marking some as deleted.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving employees by role, with filters for termination status.

methods.name: testUserStatusByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username exists in the system.
